material: You will introduce student award recipients at a ceremony. You are unsure how to pronounce one recipient’s name, and the printed list contains only its written form. You know the recipient through a class and want to ask respectfully before the event.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: pronounce 是读出名字；主动求准确，不把名字说成麻烦或奇怪。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文给当面或语音选择，问重音及希望公布的名字形式，限定录音用途；不能把练习用录音直接当典礼素材播放。

material: You serve on a neighborhood committee. The draft minutes say a new parking plan was unanimously approved, but you and another member voted against it because delivery access was unresolved. The plan did receive a majority vote. Write to the committee secretary.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 多数通过与两人反对都由题干给出；更正一致通过的记录并提出核对，不需论证停车政策本身，标适中。
answer_evidence: 范文承认决议有效，要求记两票反对及送货通道顾虑，并可与主席核对；长篇重辩停车方案会偏离秘书的记录职责。

material: You belong to a neighborhood time bank, where members exchange hours of help. You spent an hour preparing materials for a member’s workshop before the member canceled it. The rules explain completed sessions but do not address preparation time. Write to the coordinator, not the canceling member.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 时数交换规则和准备工作缺口已有解释；陈述事实、求适用说明及建议事先约定，不以不熟悉的 time bank 场景标困难。
answer_evidence: 范文分开已做准备与未办活动，向协调员问适用规则，再建议预约时先约定准备额度及取消处理；向成员直接讨时数会跳过核实。

material: You are selecting packaging for your student-run shop. A supplier advertises a container as “eco-friendly” but gives no details about its materials or how customers should dispose of it. Your campus accepts only certain packaging types in its recycling bins.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 询问材质、处理条件并说明购买取决于校内适用性；不要求知道具体回收技术或认证，按适中请求信息任务处理。
answer_evidence: 范文要材质、回收或堆肥条件和专门收集要求，再对校内清单决定；可堆肥不等于可放任意回收箱，不能仅凭宣传下单。

material: You bought a block of concert tickets for your friends. One friend, Max, can no longer attend and asks you to promise a refund immediately. The organizer permits ticket transfers but says refunds are available only if the concert is canceled. The concert is still going ahead.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: transfer 是转让，refund 是退款；允许前者不代表保证后者。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明演出未取消，提代问朋友并先核价格及联系方式授权；急于安慰而保证退款会超出自己和主办方权限。

material: You attended a new-members evening at a local museum. The curator’s talk about how objects are selected for exhibitions was interesting, but first-time visitors did not learn how to book activities or join volunteer projects. The membership coordinator has asked you for feedback on the evening.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: practical gap 是实际操作信息缺口；反馈须保留成功部分而非全盘否定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先讲策展人分享价值，再指出不会报名和加入志愿项目，给末尾五分钟及信息台；仅要求“更多互动”未对准困惑。

material: You agreed to judge a student photography contest. After receiving the entries, you recognize one photograph as your cousin’s work, even though the entries use numbers rather than names. You have not scored any entry yet. Write to the contest organizer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 尚未评分及亲属关系已给出；披露、提出回避并询程序即可，伦理情节不能单独替代实际语言负担，标适中。
answer_evidence: 范文在未评分时披露，建议回避该项或整体替换，并不向其他评委透露身份；保证“我绝对公正”不能消除程序疑虑。

material: You are joining a beginner’s knitting class at a community center. You are left-handed, and the course description says demonstrations will be shown from a right-handed perspective. You do not need a separate class but want to know how to follow the demonstrations.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: perspective 是观察角度；提出学习需要，不先认定左右手必须分班。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文问对坐或推荐位置，只求短暂动作核对，并愿预习图示；直接要求老师重录整套内容可能超过所需帮助。

material: You coordinate a neighborhood street meal. Volunteers want to place tables across the only walkway to several homes to create a long shared table. Residents must still be able to reach their front doors throughout the event. Write to the table-layout volunteer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: continuous path 是连续通路；不是只有入口留一个空隙就够。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留社交目标、改成单侧短桌，并检查坐人后椅子外伸；只量空桌间距可能活动开始才堵住住户出入。

material: Your student café runs a pay-it-forward program: customers buy extra drink vouchers for other students. Staff currently call out recipients’ names and announce that their drinks were donated. A student has privately said this feels embarrassing. The café already uses order numbers for other purchases. You coordinate the program.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: discreet 是不张扬；隐私改进不能顺带丢掉代金券核销记录。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不泄露投诉者，用普通订单号取饮品、内部记券号，之后对账；把所有记录取消虽低调，却无法核实项目使用。

material: You are co-hosting an online seminar on September 30 at 10:00 UTC, which is 18:00 in the guest speaker’s UTC+8 location. The original invitation said only “10:00,” without a time zone. The speaker can attend the intended slot but asks for clarification. The plan is a twenty-minute presentation and fifteen minutes of moderated questions.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: time zone 是时区；必须让双方确认同一时刻，而非只保证以后补说明。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文给九月三十日UTC十点与嘉宾当地十八点，补日历并请核对，再说明二十分钟报告、十五分钟主持问答；不可只写“上午十点”。

material: Your student association voted to hold a consultation meeting at 8 p.m. Most voters live on campus, while commuter representatives have explained that their last bus leaves earlier. You helped run the poll and want the chair to reconsider how commuters can participate.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: consultation 是征求意见；多数人的方便不能证明其他群体能参与。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明末班车障碍，提出早场或书面通道，关键是决定前纳入讨论；会后才收建议只是形式补救。

material: You borrowed a family friend’s old wooden picture frame for a theater display. During packing, a corner was scratched. The frame has sentimental value, and you have not tried to repair it. Write to the owner before returning it.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: sentimental value 是情感价值；赔礼不等于自行决定修复方法。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文明确划伤及责任，不试涂盖，先给照片、商量专业修复并承担合理费用；直接买新框无法替代原物意义。

material: You are taking over as treasurer of a student club. The outgoing treasurer offers to send their personal email password because the club’s payment account uses that address. You want continuity without taking control of the former officer’s private messages.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 题干已指定通过服务商转官方邮箱的替代办法；说明边界并索取交接记录，不需自行设计身份认证或财务制度，标适中。
answer_evidence: 范文拒收个人密码，按服务商流程换社团联系地址，再核余额、待付款和周期扣费；只有能登录不代表账目交接完成。

material: Your community center has invited residents to contribute objects for a temporary “Everyday History” display. You own an old bus pass from your first job and would like to lend it, not donate it permanently. Write to the exhibition organizer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: loan 是借展，donation 是捐赠；物件价值可来自日常经历而非名贵。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文用第一份工作的通勤故事解释关联，明确临时借出，再问纸品保护、署名和归还；只介绍故事会漏掉所有权与返还安排。

material: You coordinate celebrations for a small office. A coworker has quietly told you they dislike surprise parties and public birthday announcements. Another colleague has already begun planning a surprise lunch for them. Write privately to that colleague.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: surprise 是惊喜安排，但对方明确不喜欢，善意不能替代其偏好。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文提私下卡片和事先询问的小聚，不把拒绝理由广播给全体；规模缩小但仍突袭，不一定尊重原请求。

material: Your course lists the third edition of a textbook, but you already own the second edition. The bookstore says both cover the main topics, while page numbers and exercises differ. You want to ask your instructor whether you can use the older copy without missing required work.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: edition 是版本；主题相似不保证题号和作业内容相同。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文问哪些任务依赖新版，拟用旧版通读，并先查图书馆是否有新版可核指定练习；记录内容差异，不能只对页码或默认一定有书可借。

material: You coordinate a new peer-mentoring program with twelve first-year students and six volunteer mentors. A partner coordinator suggests assigning two students to each mentor immediately, but you have not collected students’ goals or mentors’ availability. You want a thoughtful matching process.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: matching 是配对；人数平均不等于目标和时间匹配。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先收目标、可用时段，再见面试配并私下复查；把调整称为试行机制能避免学生为怕得罪导师而不反映问题。

material: You hired a photographer for a student conference. The agreement includes twenty edited images, but your committee now asks for every unedited file as well. The committee wants to document small-group sessions as well as the main presentations. You are the contact person and want to explore options without treating extra work as already included.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: deliverables 是约定交付物；新增需求不能写成摄影师原本就欠交。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先认二十张精修，解释小组活动用途并开放更多精修的替代，问费用、时间及使用条件；先承诺加购再问委员会会越权。

material: Your friend has asked you to review a speech they will give at your birthday dinner. It includes a humorous story about your unsuccessful audition that you do not want shared with the guests. You both enjoy remembering how you got lost on your first campus tour. You appreciate the effort and want to suggest that story instead.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: omitted 是被省略掉的；设定隐私边界不必指责朋友想羞辱自己。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文点名试镜失败故事，说明不想公开，换共同迷路趣事，且无需向客人解释删改；含糊说“别太尴尬”不够可执行。

material: A coworker uses keyboard shortcuts to process routine spreadsheet reports much faster than you do. They have offered to help, but you do not want to interrupt them repeatedly during deadlines. Write to arrange a short, focused learning session.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: focused 是聚焦；请求同事帮助要具体且可控，不是无限次随时教学。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文锁定跳转与重复格式，备示例数据、约二十分钟，之后自写清单练习；只说“教我Excel”会扩大对方负担。

material: You found a USB drive beside the workshop tables after yesterday’s session at the community center. A message in the event group asks whoever found it to open the files and identify the owner. You have not connected the drive to a computer. Write to the center’s front-desk supervisor.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: claimant 是来认领的人；找失主不代表获准浏览文件。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文未连接设备，交前台失物流程，用外观和使用地点核身份，群里仅报失物；公开截图找主人反而扩散私人内容。

material: Your art instructor wants to display students’ early sketches beside finished work to show the creative process. You are willing to participate, but your sketchbook pages include private notes unrelated to the project. Write before the instructor collects the books.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: creative process 是创作过程；展示真实发展不需要公开整本私人笔记。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文选能显示构图变化的扫描页、仅遮无关私记，交老师先看；只交精修后的新草图会把真实过程伪装成展示稿。

material: You help run a beginner chess tournament at a community center. Some new players leave after losing their first match because they assume they are eliminated. The event actually guarantees everyone three games, regardless of results. Write to the volunteer handling announcements.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: eliminated 是被淘汰；本赛制保证三盘，不由第一盘输赢决定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把留场、查配对和等待位置连成动作，再询新手输棋后会怎么做验证理解；重复“三轮制”术语不一定消除误会。

material: You will demonstrate a student-built website at a public showcase. The organizer says the venue’s internet may be unreliable. Your team’s live demonstration normally needs a connection, but you can prepare a recorded walkthrough and local screenshots. Write to your teammate who is presenting with you.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: backup 是备用方案，不表示提前宣布演示必然失败。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文在网络稳定时仍做现场演示，备录屏与本地截图并明确标注，约定一次失败即切换；不能把录制过程冒充现场功能。

material: You organize a community clothing swap. A volunteer has proposed sorting clothes into “normal sizes” and “large sizes.” Items come from different brands, so size labels vary, and you want shoppers to feel welcome rather than judged. Write to the sorting volunteer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: normal sizes 暗含某些体型不正常；品牌尺码差异也让该分类不实用。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文按衣物种类、原尺码及缺标时的实测尺寸组织，再模拟找衣服；只把“正常”换“普通”仍可能保留评判。

material: You volunteer as a campus buddy for incoming students. Your assigned student, Luis, has said the welcome email contains too many links and that they do not know where to begin. They arrive next week and have already arranged housing.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: priority 是先后重点；对方缺的是起步顺序，不是更多链接。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文跳过已办住房，按账户、学生卡、迎新安排排序，再只问一个最急问题；把所有资源重发会增加同样负担。

material: You are co-chairing a volunteer committee meeting scheduled for one hour. The draft agenda includes twelve routine updates and two decisions needed that evening. Your co-chair wants every update read aloud, but you are concerned the decisions will be rushed.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: routine updates 是例行通报，不等于需要讨论的决策。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把通报提前发、留十分钟问变动，两项各二十分钟、末十分钟分工，总计一小时；单纯要求大家讲快点没有保护决策时间。

material: You organized a restaurant dinner for six friends. Before booking, two friends said they wanted to pay only for what they ordered because their budgets were tight. You agreed to individual payment before making the booking. Another friend now suggests splitting the total equally for convenience. You want to settle the arrangement before dinner.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: equally 是均分，不一定符合此前按个人点单支付的约定。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不公开朋友预算，先问分账、再记录个人及自选共享项，并预先讨论服务费；到结账才谈会让人难以拒绝。

material: Your neighbor walks your dog once a week. During a recent walk together, your dog stopped repeatedly and tried to turn back near a crowded street market. Your neighbor usually takes that route because it is convenient. A quieter path around the playing field is available but less direct. You want to request a quieter route without diagnosing the dog’s behavior.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: tried to turn back 是试图往回走；应写观察到的停步回头，不擅自诊断病因。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文请求绕安静球场、可缩短其他路段避免加时，并问可行性；“你必须让它习惯”既超出证据又增加邻居责任。

material: You want to enter a community art contest with a digitally created illustration printed on paper. The entry form allows “original artwork,” while an older information sheet says “handmade entries only.” Entries close next Friday, and you have not paid the fee.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: original 是原创，handmade 是手工；纸上成品不自动解决制作方式限制。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文并列现旧措辞，说明数字创作后打印，问有效规则及原创证明；不能把“我自己做的”当作规则已经允许。

material: Your three-person class team is building a study planner. With one week left, a teammate proposes adding a social chat feature, while the required calendar and reminder functions still need testing. You want to preserve the teammate’s idea without risking an incomplete submission.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: required 是必须交付；新功能有价值不代表现在值得加入。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先认可协作价值，把聊天记为未来扩展及草图，不冒充已实现；先承诺聊天再赌测试够快会使必要功能失守。

material: You tested a museum’s new audio guide as a volunteer. The narrator’s speech is clear when heard alone, but the background music makes some object descriptions hard to follow. The audio producer has asked for specific feedback before release.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: balance 是声音比例；问题在配乐与人声竞争，不是口音或讲者能力。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留转场音乐、讲述时降低，并用同设备对比及复述测理解；只问“好不好听”测不到内容是否听清。

material: You meet a language-exchange partner weekly to practice English and Mandarin. Recently, nearly the whole hour has been spent on your partner’s English practice, leaving little time for your Mandarin questions. You value the friendship and want a more reciprocal arrangement.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: reciprocal 是互相受益；要说时间分配事实，不猜对方故意占便宜。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文各二十五分钟、轮换先后并双方带问题，给调整空间；固定把自己的语言排末尾仍容易被超时挤掉。

material: You coordinate volunteers at a weekend festival. A volunteer reports finishing a shift but says no supervisor was available to sign their hours sheet. Your records show the volunteer checked in, but you still need confirmation of the work period before issuing a participation letter.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: sign-off 是负责人确认；签到只证明到场，不证明全部服务时长。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文承认流程缺口，要岗位、结束时间和同组成员，自己找负责人核实后发信；直接按自报时数证明或让志愿者重跑全流程都不妥。

material: Your backyard tree has produced more apples than your household can use. You would like to offer some to a neighbor who coordinates a community cooking group. Some apples have marks on their skin. You can provide one collection this week but cannot promise a regular supply.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: one collection 是本周一次领取，不是长期供货承诺。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明一次性与外观瑕疵，让料理组按用途查看自选、带容器，先问计划是否需要；不能替对方保证所有果实质量或稳定数量。

material: A colleague wants to try cycling to work and has asked to join your commute. Your usual route includes a steep hill, while a flatter route takes longer. Your colleague has not described their cycling experience. Write to plan a first ride without assuming their abilities.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: flatter 是坡度更缓，不等于更短；先了解经验和到达约束。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文把两路差异说清，问近期骑行及时间，提宽裕日慢骑或先探部分路线；“跟紧我就行”把同事能力默认成自己水平。

material: You are helping create a neighborhood history map. An old source uses street names that are no longer current. The designer plans to replace every old name with its modern equivalent, but some changes are uncertain and visitors also need to understand the historical record.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: equivalent 是对应名称；现名替换会掩盖尚未证实的对应关系。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文保留历史层原名，只给核实者括注现名，未定者明示，再逐项找档案核对；看起来整齐不应以伪确定性换取。

material: Your roommate has twice borrowed your noise-canceling headphones without asking. You use them for online tutoring appointments and could not find them before one session. You are willing to lend them occasionally, but need a clear agreement.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: permission 是明确同意，未回复不代表默认允许。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文只列两次及一次课前找不到的影响，规定先问等回复、定时原处归还；“别老拿”夸大频率且没给可用规则。

material: Your student science website is adding a glossary for readers with little scientific background. A classmate who is not taking science courses has offered to review it. You want feedback on understanding rather than asking the classmate to verify technical accuracy.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: glossary 是术语表；请初学者检验可理解性，不要求其担当技术审核。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文让选五条复述并圈陌生词，拟请老师另查科学准确性；只问“读懂了吗”易获笼统回答，代写又会增加不必要负担。

material: You co-wrote a popular online guide to using a campus software service. The service has changed its menu, and readers now report that your old instructions lead to the wrong settings page. Your coauthor wants to wait until next term for a complete rewrite.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: outdated 是已过时；全面重写可以等，继续误导读者不能一并搁置。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先显著标出旧段、指向现行指引并撤误导步骤，核对后发布；凭记忆快速改新路径可能再制造错误。

material: You coordinate a family storytelling performance at a library. The performer has asked to begin twenty minutes late so an invited photographer can attend. The advertised finishing time must remain unchanged because families have arranged transport. Write to the performer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: finishing time 是硬约束；晚开始二十分钟实际损失的是观众节目时长。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不简单拒绝摄影，提安静入场和结束后仅与愿意且有空留下者摆拍、仍需照片许可，并请确认原时程；把结束也顺延忽略交通安排。

material: During a neighborhood clean-up, volunteers found several old inscribed stones beside a disused building. The event instructions say unusual objects must be left in place and reported to the site manager. Some volunteers want to take the stones to the community center for display. Write to your clean-up team.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: inscribed 是有刻字；发现物有趣不等于志愿队获准搬走展出。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文依据题内活动规则，原地记录位置与照片，向场地负责人请示，其他区域继续普通清扫；不能把未知物直接称珍贵文物。

material: Your workplace is launching a wellness challenge based entirely on daily step counts. A colleague who uses a wheelchair has said they want to join but cannot use that measure. You are on the organizing team and want an inclusive proposal without requesting private health details.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: measure 是衡量标准；统一步数并不天然公平，也无需索取诊断来证明障碍。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文改为自选可行目标和完成规律，不硬换算轮椅活动与步数，自愿询问活动偏好而不索病史；另设“特殊组”仍可能使人被标签化。

material: You are helping your cousin prepare for a first job interview. Your cousin wants to memorize a long script you wrote together, but the practice answers sound unnatural when questions are phrased differently. You want to adjust the preparation plan supportively.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: script 是逐字稿；记住故事不等于所有问题都适合照背同一段。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文指出换问法时不自然，把经历拆情境、行动、结果，三种团队问题练选细节；先追漂亮句子会继续忽略问题焦点。

material: Your class team has two different versions of a report, both named “final.” The newer copy has the revised conclusion, while the older copy has corrected evidence-table entries that are missing from the newer one. A teammate proposes deleting the older file based only on its modification date. You have one day before submission.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: modification date 是修改时间，不能证明包含全部正确修改。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文指出新版结论与旧版表格各有价值，保留原件、分段核并合并后通读；只重命名或删旧档不能消除内容冲突。

material: You are helping organize a children’s museum treasure hunt. The draft plan requires a phone to scan a code at every station. Some families will not have a suitable device or will prefer not to hand one to a child. Write to the activity designer.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: equivalent 是信息和挑战相当，不只是多放一张纸就算替代。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文让线索卡与扫码内容一致，用纸表记录，并分组试跑找困惑；给纸版更多提示会无意改变难度而非只改渠道。

material: In your four-person class team, you have taken notes and sent follow-up messages at every meeting. The others do most of the presentation speaking. You want to practice presenting too, but the administrative tasks still need to be done. Write to the whole team before the next meeting.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: rotation 是轮换；诉求同时是劳动分配和学习机会，不是取消杂务。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文准确描述一直记笔记，要求下次讲开场并由别人记录，提前列角色、简化模板；只表达不满却没人接手会使任务落空。

material: You are ordering uniforms for a recreational team. The supplier’s size chart lists only “small,” “medium,” and “large,” with no measurements. The team must submit one group order, and exchanges are limited. You want to avoid asking members to guess.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: garment measurements 是衣服实测尺寸；字母尺码不提供足够依据。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文索尺寸及量法，或借试穿样衣，再问截止能否容纳核对；直接让队友平常穿什么就订什么忽略换货限制。

material: Your cousin will stay with you for three days during your examination week. You are happy to host, but your cousin has sent a full sightseeing plan that assumes you can accompany them all day. You can share evenings after studying, not daytime outings.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: accompany 是陪同；欢迎住宿不等于白天全程导游。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文在订活动前划白天学习、晚上相处，提供路线规划帮助；先答应全日游再临时失约，或只冷淡拒绝，都难兼顾关系和考试。

material: You organize an amateur astronomy evening. The forecast provided by the venue predicts heavy cloud, but the event can use an indoor room. Tickets advertised “a chance to observe the night sky,” not guaranteed views. Write to registered participants before they travel.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: chance 是机会，不是保证；预报提示可能受阻，不能写成天气已成定局。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文说明室内架镜与星图练习的价值，也承认不能等同亲眼观察，要求出发前确认或询预订选择；不能自行许诺题面没给的退款政策。

material: Your neighborhood association is preparing a memorial notice for a long-serving volunteer. You have been asked to write it, but the family has not approved the wording or said whether they want funeral details published. Write sensitively to the family’s designated contact.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: memorial notice 是悼念文字；团体想感谢不等于能公布葬礼和私事。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文先慰问、询是否愿公开及范围，提供短稿慢慢审核，允许不发；催家属马上补全资料会把纪念变成负担。

material: You tested a new student-made quiz app and found that the explanation screen displays the correct reasoning, but the final review labels the same response wrong. You can reproduce this using a practice account. Write to the student developer with useful evidence, not a general complaint.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: mismatch 是两处不一致；不是直接断定哪段程序出错。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文按作答、看解析、完成测验复现，提供题号与双截图，说明学习影响；“评分坏了”缺定位证据，也不该发送真实学习记录。

material: You are planning a student club’s annual meeting. The nomination form assumes every member can attend in person to stand for a committee role. A member on a semester exchange wants to nominate themselves and serve remotely for the first month if elected. The club rules do not clearly address this situation.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: eligible 是有参选资格；表格默认现场不一定等于正式禁止远程。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文不先批准或排除，查规则与必须到场的职责，再向所有候选人同步说明；只给熟悉成员开私下例外会损害程序公平。

material: Your graduating class plans to seal letters in a time capsule and open it at a reunion ten years later. The organizer proposes reading every letter aloud at that reunion, but contributors have not been told this. You are helping collect the letters.
skills: 任务覆盖与具体细节 / 收件人关系与语气 / 可执行的沟通
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: read aloud 是公开朗读；十年后用途需在现在收信时说明。 难度来自任务整合与表达要求，非官方等级。
answer_evidence: 范文区分私下返还与允许分享，信封和登记双记选择，并考虑组织者更替；只靠现任口头记住许可无法跨越十年。 在开始收信前说明未来用途和选择，不预设已收信而遗漏补核许可。

material: Professor: A college is reconsidering how teachers mark essays. Removing student names could reduce the influence of earlier impressions, but teachers sometimes need to know a writer to understand the progress that an essay represents. The essays would still receive written feedback. Should the college require anonymous grading for major written assignments?
skills: 区分评价目的 / 提出可行流程
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需区分评分标准与形成性反馈，论证有流程而非简单二选一。
answer_evidence: 范文先记录分数再显示姓名，以证据使用的进步说明个别反馈，并承认文风可能暴露身份。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A course instructor wants students to complete an ungraded practice task before an important examination. The practice task would resemble the examination but use different questions. Some students welcome a chance to discover weaknesses, while others already have demanding schedules. Should completion of this practice task be required for everyone?
skills: 明确活动目的 / 用例子解释机制
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 情境熟悉，重点在必做范围与诊断作用之间建立清晰联系。
answer_evidence: 范文以事实清单不等于论证为例，要求短诊断、按需加练，并排除表现分造成的干扰。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A university laboratory has fewer desirable afternoon booking times than students requesting them. Currently, the fastest students to complete an online form get those times. Staff are considering a lottery instead, but some experiments need particular schedules. How should the laboratory distribute its most popular booking times fairly?
skills: 区分需要与偏好 / 限定公平规则
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需要同时处理必要性、机会公平与资源总量，限制条件较多。
answer_evidence: 固定间隔观测支撑优先权，剩余时段抽签；容量不足是分配规则无法单独解决的边界。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A university advising office is testing a program that recommends courses based on students' previous grades and choices. It might help students find suitable classes more quickly, but it could also direct them toward familiar subjects. Should these recommendations become the main starting point for academic advising, or remain an optional extra?
skills: 区分工具与决策 / 举反例拓展讨论
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需以具体转向说明历史信息的局限，避免抽象讨论技术优劣。
answer_evidence: 生物与舞台设计的假设例子支撑先问目标，再由工具核查条件的方案。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A department receives occasional reports of errors in its course textbooks. It is considering a shared page where students can report possible mistakes and suggest corrections. Staff would check submissions, but reviewing them takes time. Should the department encourage this activity as part of learning, or handle corrections only through teachers?

answer_evidence: 新图找趋势让理解显现，可跳过照顾复习者，以后续应用而非时长评价。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A product review website is considering allowing ratings only from users who can show that they purchased the item through a partner store. This could reduce some questionable reviews, but it would exclude people who received gifts or bought elsewhere. Should proof of purchase be required for every rating, or used only as an additional label?
skills: 区分证据含义 / 避免认证光环
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需识别购买与使用两个变量，保留有用经验且回应操纵问题。
answer_evidence: 礼物耳机长期使用与买家配送评论的对比揭示凭证局限。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A supermarket offers its best discounts only through a phone application that customers must show at checkout. Managers say the application makes promotions efficient, but some regular shoppers do not use smartphones. Should the store keep these discounts exclusive to the application, or make the same prices available through a simpler alternative?
skills: 分析数字门槛 / 比较完整服务成本
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 熟悉购物案例，以相同价格的替代渠道回应数字排除。
answer_evidence: 小屏结账困难与实体卡替代具体化公平，排队解释成本回应效率顾虑。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A workplace plans an optional activity challenge using personal devices to count daily steps. Teams would compete for small prizes, and a shared board would display totals. Some employees enjoy competition, while others cannot or do not want to share movement data. Should the workplace use this format or design a broader activity program?
skills: 检验目标与指标 / 识别群体压力
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需区分社交目标与身体指标，不提出医疗效果主张。
answer_evidence: 不同活动的共同休息保留社交目的，去排名和不追踪拒绝减轻压力。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A town wants to understand where late evening noise is most disruptive. Officials propose installing devices that record sound levels but not conversations, while residents suggest voluntary complaint diaries instead. Each method has gaps and costs. Which source should guide the town's first response to noise problems in shared public areas?
skills: 结合定量与体验 / 检验数据边界
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需综合报告偏差、测量值和体验影响，并确认隐私边界。
answer_evidence: 深夜装卸的共同日记线索引导临时测量，短事件与重复扰眠区分决策依据。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A local news website sometimes corrects important mistakes in published articles. It currently changes the text and adds a short note at the bottom, but most readers never return to the article. Editors are considering displaying major corrections on the homepage. Should corrections receive that visibility, even when it highlights the website's errors?
skills: 按影响分级 / 追踪信息后果
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需把更正看作影响修复，区分重大事实与轻微文字修正。
answer_evidence: 社区中心误报关闭造成计划改变，按重要性和触达范围安排更正。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A local newspaper covers many community problems but has limited space to report how other places have responded to similar issues. Editors propose a regular column examining possible solutions. Some reporters welcome it, while others worry about sounding promotional. Should the newspaper devote more space to these responses or concentrate on exposing local problems?
skills: 检验成功叙事 / 分析方案迁移
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需区别调查响应方案与推广方案，并检验迁移前提。
answer_evidence: 公交衔接改善同时查冷门线路损失和司机条件，展示带限制的解决报道。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A student newspaper interviews people about campus issues. Some interviewees ask to read their quotations before publication to check accuracy, while editors worry that this could let sources reshape uncomfortable statements. Should the newspaper routinely offer quotation checks, refuse them, or use a narrower process that protects both accuracy and editorial independence?
skills: 区分准确与控制 / 明确沟通预期
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需精确区分事实核查、用语澄清与来源审批权。
answer_evidence: 研究术语核对与撤回清楚记录的观点相对照，事前说明流程保护双方预期。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A neighborhood discussion board is growing quickly. Volunteer moderators can either approve every new post before it appears or let posts appear immediately and review reported problems afterward. Residents use the board for both urgent requests and longer debates. Which moderation approach would best keep the space useful without overwhelming its volunteers?
skills: 按传播后果分流 / 限定平台职责
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需按内容后果而非统一快慢制定审核规则。
answer_evidence: 蓝包求助与点名指责对照说明审核差异，明确时间及紧急服务边界。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A documentary about an event with little surviving footage plans to include scenes performed by actors. The director can label each scene as a reconstruction or explain this technique once at the beginning. Repeated labels might interrupt the story, but viewers may join late. How should the documentary distinguish reconstructed scenes from original records?
skills: 区分呈现与证据 / 考虑脱离上下文传播
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 开头一次说明与每段标注的争点、晚进入和片段传播均已给出；范文的独立史料分析是可选贡献，不据此标困难。
answer_evidence: 单方回忆的私谈场景揭示新增细节风险，每段标记与开场来源说明相辅。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A history teacher posts recorded lessons with short chapter summaries beside each video. Students can read the summaries before watching, but some say this makes it tempting to skip the explanations. Others use them to decide where they need help. Should the teacher keep detailed summaries or replace them with brief topic headings?
skills: 设计自我检验 / 区分学习媒介与成果
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 熟悉复习场景，以证据问题判断是否需重看而非控制观看。
answer_evidence: 工厂扩建创造岗位与增加邻里噪声的假设自测连接定位与理解，允许文本学习者不完整看视频。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A film club is discussing adaptations of well known novels. A director has changed a novel's unhappy ending to a more hopeful one, arguing that film audiences need a different experience. Some readers feel this changes the central meaning. Should filmmakers preserve a book's ending, or freely reshape it for a new medium and audience?
skills: 检验叙事一致性 / 避免审美绝对化
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 借虚构人物的转变解释叙事支撑，不依赖具体文学作品。
answer_evidence: 从拒绝帮助到学会倾听支撑和解，区别于没有铺垫的结局替换。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A local sports league is considering using video replays to review disputed decisions during games. The equipment is affordable, but volunteers would need training and reviews could interrupt play. Players value both fairness and a relaxed atmosphere. Should the league introduce replays, or continue relying on the officials' decisions made during the game?
skills: 评估证据充分性 / 限制程序成本
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需区分有影像与有决定性证据，同时衡量比赛节奏。
answer_evidence: 球被遮挡时维持原判说明证据限度，有限事项与试行控制时间和人手。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A community sports club welcomes adults with very different experience levels. For weekly casual games, members can either choose teams with their friends or let organizers arrange balanced teams. Newcomers sometimes receive little playing time. Which approach would make the club more enjoyable while keeping people motivated to return regularly?
skills: 区分形式与实际参与 / 明确活动定位
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 熟悉休闲体育，用传球机会展示超越比分的参与标准。
answer_evidence: 新人接不到球说明参与不均，轮换位置与明确休闲目标回应归属需求。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A community center runs an afternoon play session for children. Staff can organize a sequence of games with rules or provide approved materials for children to invent their own activities under supervision. Parents want the session to be enjoyable and worthwhile. Which approach should occupy most of the time, and why?
skills: 区分支持与控制 / 回应参与差异
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 需解释自由活动如何获得起点和参与支持，不扩展为安全指导。
answer_evidence: 想象动物住所的共同挑战兼顾开放选择，角色观察防止强势者垄断。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A town funds a community choir that performs at several public celebrations each year. The conductor proposes auditions because rehearsal time is limited and the concerts should sound polished. Other members believe anyone who wants to sing should be welcome. Should the choir select singers by current ability or accept all interested residents?
skills: 回应效率与参与的冲突 / 用分层任务支持立场
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: current ability 是现有水平；题目权衡有限排练时间下的演出质量与居民参与机会。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文赞成开放加入，但新增“按成员能力选曲”的办法：新手唱重复旋律，熟手唱和声，以同一作品安排不同挑战；另分专业小组，避免把开放参与写成所有演出都无条件上场。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: An adult photography course currently gives every learner the same weekly assignment. The instructor is considering letting learners develop personal projects instead, while teaching a common set of techniques. Some participants photograph family events, and others prefer buildings or landscapes. Which assignment approach would make the course more useful for this mixed group?
skills: 区分学习目标与题材 / 构造可比较的例证
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: personal projects 是个人选题项目；争点是贴近兴趣与便于比较学习效果。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文把“共同题材”换成“共同技术标准”：家庭聚餐与门口照片都比较光线方向，既保留兴趣又能互评；先做短共同练习，说明自由选题仍需明确学习目标。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A neighborhood tool library lends equipment that residents use only occasionally. Volunteers are deciding whether to spend their small training budget on more written instructions or on short practical introductions for first-time borrowers. Existing safety restrictions would apply in either case. Which form of support should receive priority, and why?
skills: 比较支持方式 / 用可观察行为检验理解
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: practical introductions 是实际操作入门指导；要权衡当场发现误解与借回家后能查阅。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增让借用者复述并指出控件的检查，用缝纫机作假设例子，说明点头不等于懂；简明说明卡延续同一内容，也不把入门课当成解除安全限制的许可。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A volunteer reading club has been organized by the same person for several years. Members value the organizer's experience, but no one else knows all the booking and planning routines. The club is considering rotating the role each term. Should leadership rotate regularly, or remain with the person who performs it well?
skills: 解释组织连续性 / 以具体交接步骤支持观点
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: rotating the role 是轮流担任组织者；要权衡经验带来的稳定与职责、知识的传承。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增“共同负责一学期”的交接：新人完整办一次活动，再记录遗漏步骤，使经验变成经过实践的流程；旧负责人有退出时间，避免名义轮换后仍全靠同一人。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A town has set aside a small budget for one neighborhood improvement. Residents can propose projects, but officials must choose among ideas that serve different numbers of people and have different maintenance needs. Should the final choice be made by a public vote or by a panel that compares the proposals using published criteria?
skills: 分解集体决策阶段 / 解释长期成本与参与边界
vocabulary: public vote / maintenance needs / paper ballots
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: published criteria 是公开的评选标准；争点是居民决定权与项目后续是否养得起。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文让小组先查可行性、居民再投票，新增比较持续维护工时的理由；阅读棚与分成多块种植区的花园是假设比较，并非断言花园总更贵。公开剔除理由与纸票让投票前后的程序也可检查。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A town can use this year's tree budget either to plant trees on several streets that have none or to improve the care of trees planted during the previous two years. Some recent plantings are struggling, and staff cannot fully fund both options. Which use of the budget should take priority?
skills: 比较维护与扩张 / 用长期成果限定评价
vocabulary: recent plantings / care plan / planting totals
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: care of trees 是树木养护；要权衡尚未受益街道的公平与已有树木能否存活。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增“先查衰弱原因，避免扩大同一失误”的理由，以种植池反复干燥为假设例子；用两年后健康数量评估成果，并公布下一批街道时间，回应养护可能变成无限拖延的担忧。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A public park has several open lawns. Its managers propose leaving part of one lawn unmown for most of the year so residents can observe a less managed growing area. Others want every lawn kept short for games and informal gatherings. How should the park balance these different uses of limited open space?
skills: 识别空间用途差异 / 设计兼顾得失的试行
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: unmown 是不修剪的；题目权衡观察自然生长与保留可实际活动的草坪。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增先观察使用位置的依据：少用边角可做试区，不能切断唯一能玩集体游戏的连续空间；还查活动是否被挤到别处，把自然体验与被替代用途一起评估。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A popular walking trail becomes crowded on a few holiday mornings but is quiet on most other days. The park is considering requiring advance reservations for all visits throughout the year. Managers want predictable visitor numbers, while residents value spontaneous walks. Would a year-round reservation system be an appropriate response to this problem?
skills: 区分问题成因 / 限定政策适用时段
vocabulary: advance reservations / arrival windows / peak periods
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: 少数高峰与全年预约的范围不匹配已由题干和 Student B 说明；不强制区分入口到达率与全程容量，标适中。
answer_evidence: 范文新增“入口同时到达”和“整条路持续拥挤”的区别：九点集中抵达可用分时到达，持续拥挤才需总量限制；不能仅因少数假日排队就限制全年所有走访。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A community garden has space for either small plots assigned to individual households or larger beds that members care for together and harvest according to shared rules. Participants have different amounts of free time and gardening experience. Which arrangement would better sustain participation and make good use of the available land?
skills: 解释合作中的责任 / 扩展贡献的衡量方式
vocabulary: shared beds / harvest rules / watering schedule
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: shared beds 是共同照料的种植区；要权衡个人付出与收获的对应、互相补位的便利。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增“贡献不只是在场工时”：订种子、排浇水表也能负责，出门家庭可提前做计划任务；先定收获规则回应不公平担忧，小试验角保留个人选择。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: An elementary school has enough money for either one full-day visit to a distant nature center or several short visits to a nearby stream during the school year. Both destinations have suitable supervised activities. Teachers want students to become curious observers, but families also value experiences children would rarely have otherwise. Which option should the school choose?
skills: 将活动与学习目标对应 / 用前后比较展开论证
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: curious observers 是愿意提问并观察的人；题目权衡少见体验与反复追踪的学习。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增固定观察同一小段岸边、画图预测再回访的步骤，把重复变成比较证据；没有变化也能论证稳定，不能为了显得学到东西而编造必然出现的自然变化。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: An intermediate language class watches short films as part of its weekly lessons. The teacher can provide subtitles in the language being learned or translations in the students' strongest language. Students need to follow the story and develop listening skills. Which subtitle option should be used first when the class watches a new scene?
skills: 区分理解背景与训练目标 / 以活动顺序回应两方意见
timing_unit: 每份（1 题，1 个小题）
rationale: subtitles 是字幕；题目权衡先看懂情节与把声音对应到目标语言词句。 难度来自对不同要求的整合和具体论证，仅为本地内容分级。
answer_evidence: 范文新增先简述朋友争论计划的背景，再听表示犹豫的说法，使目标语言字幕服务于具体听力任务；不懂处再查译文、最后去字幕重看，难度太高仍需调整。 本地参考示例，非官方满分答案；其他有充分论证的立场也可接受。

material: Professor: A university degree includes several elective courses that students may take outside their main subject. A department proposes replacing some of them with advanced courses in the major because graduates need strong professional preparation. Others value the chance to explore unrelated fields. Should the university narrow these choices or preserve the current elective space?
skills: 构造跨领域例证 / 限定功利性论证
vocabulary: elective courses / visual storytelling / professional preparation
